abstract: Maintains aircraft performance limits, airfield operational constraints, and primary structural payload records
system_message:
You are Flight operations superintendent (FLTOPS). The flight operations superintendent (FLTOPS) oversees aircraft performance envelopes, forward airfield operating limitations, and structural payload capacities for candidate airborne research detachments. In this role, the superintendent logs and verifies vertical gust load acceleration limits under severe atmospheric conditions, balanced take-off runway requirements for forward airstrips, main-deck scientific instrument capacities, and base facility hangar footprint allocations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hangar footprint management（HNGR）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-HNGR-B9D：Facility records for the Turboprop Low-Level Penetration Detachment document an enclosed hangar floor footprint of 1400 m2 within the forward staging base hangar bay.
FLTOPS-HNGR-MT6：Facility records for the Heavy-Lift Long-Range Atmospheric Detachment reflect an enclosed hangar floor footprint of 1100 m2 within the forward staging base hangar bay.
FLTOPS-HNGR-1GN：Facility records for the High-Altitude Jet Profiling Detachment indicate an enclosed hangar floor footprint of 850 m2 within the forward staging base hangar bay.

information_points.title: Maintains aircraft performance limits, airfield operational constraints, and primary structural payload records（FLTOP）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-FLTOP-WCS：For the Turboprop Low-Level Penetration Detachment, the certified vertical structural acceleration load factor in severe convective boundary-layer flight establishes a turbulence gust acceleration tolerance of 4.0 g. Under maximum take-off weight and standard sea-level temperature at the forward operating island airstrip, the required runway take-off distance is 2300 m, and the structural payload allocation for primary sensors and instrumentation across the main cabin floor attachment points is 1800 kg.
FLTOPS-FLTOP-8HC：For the Heavy-Lift Long-Range Atmospheric Detachment, the certified vertical structural acceleration limit within the severe convective boundary-layer flight envelope provides a turbulence gust acceleration tolerance of 2.8 g. Airfield performance modeling for the forward operating island airstrip at maximum take-off weight and standard sea-level conditions defines a runway take-off distance of 2100 m, alongside a primary sensor payload capacity of 2200 kg secured on main cabin structural floor attachment points.
FLTOPS-FLTOP-I3S：For the High-Altitude Jet Profiling Detachment, the aeroelastic structural limit report for the severe convective boundary-layer flight envelope certifies a turbulence gust acceleration tolerance of 3.6 g before triggering structural inspection criteria. Operational runway take-off distance calculations for a forward operating island airstrip at maximum take-off weight and standard sea-level temperature indicate a required balanced field length of 2300 m, while the main cabin floor attachment points provide a primary sensor payload capacity of 2600 kg.
